item.title: "We'll have more stuff next year" After being somewhat absent from The Game Awards, Xbox boss teases a Dev Direct for January 2026
item.description: The Game Awards has only just wrapped, but already we've already got another (vague) date in our calendars: January 2026. Per an interview with Microsoft’s president of game content and studios, Matt Booty, in Variety, Xbox will be hosting one of its Dev Direct streams in January. Read more

item.title: Mega Man's finally making a comeback, but his first big game in years is still a while away
item.description: Mega Man! It turns out Capcom hasn't forgotten about the blue robo-dude with the 'tude - last seen in his own mainline game seven years ago - after all. The publisher has unveiled a brand-new entry in its beloved action-platformer series, but you'll need to be patient as it's still a while away from release. Read more

item.title: "The scripts are incredible, and very funny" - Sigourney Weaver confirms she will play Wallace in live-action Tomb Raider series
item.description: Sigourney Weaver has accepted a role in Amazon's upcoming Tomb Raider series from Phoebe Waller-Bridge. Read more

item.title: Terminator 2D: No Fate review
item.description: Terminator 2D: No Fate's story mode opens with a shot of a rolling stretch of tarmac, its yellow centre lines infinitely scrolling past at regular intervals as moody, industrial music plays out behind it. It's a sight that should feel familiar to any fan of Terminator 2: Judgement Day, as it's similar, but not identical, to the final scene of the movie's theatrical release. item.title: 2026's Street Fighter movie gets first-look trailer, and it includes a great reference to the series' most famous bonus stage
item.description: Film adaptations of video games are pretty hot at the moment, with the likes of The Minecraft Movie and The Super Mario Bros. Movie making big money. Next year we're getting a new take on Street Fighter, and now we've got the first look at it in action. Read more

item.title: Current Xbox console exclusive South of Midnight to release on PS5 and Switch 2 in Spring 2026
item.description: Compulsion Games has revealed that its current Xbox console exclusive, South of Midnight, will be coming to other consoles in Spring 2026. The game, which is set in a fictionalised American Deep South and makes use of a stop-motion inspired art style, is now confirmed to be releasing on PS5 and Switch 2. Read more

item.title: After a seven year wait, Bandai Namco's classic aerial combat series will return in 2026 with Ace Combat 8
item.description: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is releasing in 2026, publisher Bandai Namco has revealed. The game, coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC, was announced during last night's The Game Awards. Read more

item.title: "Littered with falsehoods and disinformation" - game workers union fires back at Rockstar's "lawless attack" once again, after GTA 6 maker's latest attempt to downplay controversial firings
item.description: UK trade union Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB) has responded once again in the continuing war of words with GTA 6 developer Rockstar, this time describing the studio's latest statement, on its controversial firing of 34 employees, as an attempt to "reverse engineer a rationale for the dismissals." Read more

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem's Leon and Grace will have differing gameplay like "jumping into a cold bath after a hot sauna"
item.description: Resident Evil Requiem's dual protagonists will represent two styles of gameplay, which its developers describe as like "jumping into a cold bath after a hot sauna". Read more

item.title: Developers at Microsoft-owned Doom studio id Software form union with CWA "to take back control of the industry we love"
item.description: Employees at Doom studio id Software have voted in favour of union representation with the Communications Workers of America (CWA), which has been recognised by Microsoft. Read more
